description: This PHP source file defines the PushEventController class, which handles HTTP requests to trigger registration event publishing within the OrangeHRM core registration plugin. The controller manages caching to avoid repeated processing and interacts with registration event processors.

classes.name: PushEventController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling event push requests, managing caching to prevent duplicate processing, and invoking registration event publisher.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request by checking cache status, instantiating the registration event processor, publishing registration events if cache is not hit, and updating cache to prevent reprocessing.
